strip.lanes: Runner lanes that may play this season
strip.playing: Matches being played on this engine
strip.perHour: Matches an hour the lanes can play, at this season's median length

finals.title: Finals
finals.intro: Once submissions close, every entry's last version plays the same number of matches from a level start, and the season closes when all have played them.

windowOpen.title: Submissions are still open.
windowOpen.body: They close {when}. Schedule the finals after that, so every entry's last submission plays them.

admitting.one: {n} submission is still being admitted. The finals wait for it.
admitting.other: {n} submissions are still being admitted. The finals wait for every one.

form.gamesHint: Every entry plays exactly this many.
form.sigmaHint: Raises every σ to this, so all start equally uncertain. Empty keeps them.
form.shrinkHint: 0 keeps each μ; 1 starts everyone at the mean.
form.estimate: About {matches} matches: {time} at the current pace.
form.estimateNoPace: About {matches} matches. There is no pace to time them by yet.

finals.cancelSaid: The countdown comes down, and the season waits for new finals.

done.title: Every entry has played its matches.
done.body: The season closes within a minute of the last match being counted, and the podium is frozen from these standings.

finals.gamesSaid: Applies to every entry at once. Lower it to end sooner, raise it for more evidence.

end.title: End {season} now?
end.body: The season closes with the standings as they are, however many finals matches each entry has played. You cannot undo it.

finals.empty: No version is on the ladder.

rounds.title: Score resets
rounds.cancelSaid: It never starts, and its countdown comes down.

blocked.waiting: A reset is already waiting. Change or cancel it first.
blocked.finals: The finals are scheduled: they are the season's last round.

fill.title: Idle fill
fill.intro: Fills idle runner lanes, least-played first, up to this many matches each in the round. The finals ignore it.

said.unknown_round: That round no longer exists. Reload the page.
said.round_waiting: A round is already waiting to start. Change or cancel it first.
said.finals_scheduled: The finals are scheduled: they are the season's last round.
said.window_open: Submissions are still open. The finals start after they close.
said.admitting: Submissions are still being admitted. The finals wait for every one.
said.round_invalid: Matches is a whole number from 1 to 100000, the sigma floor above 0, mu shrink from 0 to 1, the countdown 0 to 1440 minutes, and the start not in the past.
said.round_started: A round that has started takes only a new number of matches.
said.fill_required: Say whether the fill is on.
said.fill_invalid: Matches is a whole number from 1 to 100000, needed while the fill is on, and lanes kept free 0 to 1000.
said.season_not_live: The season is no longer live, or someone already asked to close it.
said.admin_only: This account does not administer seasons.
